question: The first passenger train in India was operated between ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay and Thane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first passenger train was on 16 April 1853 between Bori Bunder (Bombay) and Thane at a distance of 34 km**__.

 __
 
• It was powered by three locomotives named Sahib, Sultan and Siddha, and had thirteen carriages.
 
• It was dedicated by **Lord Dalhousie**__.
 
• The passenger line was built and operated by the Great Indian Peninsula Railway.
 
• It was built in a 1,676 mm broad gauge, which became the country's standard for railways.​
